title: Platform alias table
description: Maps a retired or relocated documentation path to the platform document that now owns it. An alias preserves lookup lineage so immutable historical references keep resolving; it never duplicates content. Cross-entry rules (unique fromPath, no chains or cycles) are checked by scripts/doc-alias-resolver.mjs, because JSON Schema cannot express them.

aliasId.description: Stable identifier; never reused for another alias.

fromPath.description: Repo-relative posix path of the old location, optionally followed by #anchor. Matched exactly, never as a glob.

toOwner.description: docs/platform/... path of the current owner. Null only for retired-with-evidence.

toAnchor.description: Heading anchor inside toOwner, or null for the whole document.

evidenceRef.description: Commit sha or evidence path that proves a retirement. Required for retired-with-evidence.

immutableRefs.description: Historical references that rely on this alias, for example decision ids or event refs. May be empty.

recordedAt.description: ISO date the alias was recorded.
